meta.purpose: Utility providers, move-in setup costs, cheapest plans/tariffs and electricity reliability for eight SLATE cities, to replace the single monthly 'Bills' line in seasons.ts/household.ts.
meta.rules: No invented numbers. null + note where not found. Every figure carries source + date. 'official' = utility/regulator page or filing; 'third-party' = comparison site or press summarising the provider (flagged, lower confidence). Promotional prices are marked promo with term and post-promo price where published.
caveats: Internet prices vary by address; the figures are each provider's advertised starting offer on the date given, not a quote.
US, UK, IE, CA mobile plans are national, so one cheapest plan per country is repeated for each city in that country.
Reliability indices are not comparable across countries without care: thresholds (1, 3 or 5 minutes), major-event/storm exclusions and planned-outage inclusion differ. Each entry states its basis.
